<thought>We need to find retrosynthetic templates that match the described chalcone‑to‑flavanone cyclization. The functional groups broken are aromatic hydroxyls and ketones, and the functional group formed is ether oxygens. We'll search the template catalog using these criteria on a representative flavanone product SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1C(O)C2=CC=CC=C2OC1C3=CC=CC=C3",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls", "ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
